title: Layman Pang
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett emphasizes the importance of embracing simplicity and living in the present moment, drawing inspiration from Layman Pong's story and the wisdom of Chinese poet Laman Peng. This involves letting go of attachments to material possessions and desires, finding humor in practice, and cultivating a sense of spontaneity and harmony. By doing so, one can find profound action and ultimate achievement, regardless of external circumstances or the passage of time.
